stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter,defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    L=[]
    for r in range(H):
        c=0
        while c<W:
            if I[r][c]!=bg:
                v=I[r][c]; s=c
                while c<W and I[r][c]==v: c+=1
                L.append(('h',r,s,c-1,v))
            else: c+=1
    for c in range(W):
        r=0
        while r<H:
            if I[r][c]!=bg:
                v=I[r][c]; s=r
                while r<H and I[r][c]==v: r+=1
                L.append(('v',c,s,r-1,v))
            else: r+=1
    # group segments by color
    g=defaultdict(list)
    for s in L: g[s[4]].append(s)
    # lines: segments with length>=2 ; markers: single cells
    lines=[s for s in L if len(range(s[2],s[3]+1))>=2]
    marks=[(s[2],s[3],s[4]) for s in L if s[2]==s[3]]
    mc={m[2] for m in marks}
    assert len(mc)==1, mc
    mc=mc.pop()
    for lr,lc0,lc1,_ in lines:
        # direction: toward other parallel line
        other=[s for s in lines if s is not next(s2 for s2 in lines if False)] if False else None
        # find other line with same orientation
        others=[s for s in lines if s[0]==lr and (s[1]!=lr or s[2]!=lc0)]
        if not others: continue
        oth=others[0]
        if lr=='h':
            dr=1 if oth[1]>lr else -1
            for mr,mc_,oc in marks:
                if oc<lc0 or oc>lc1: continue
                off=mr-lc0
                # map onto other line's span start
                ro=oth[2]+off
                if not (oth[2]<=ro<=oth[3]): continue
                rr=ro+dr
                while 0<=rr<H:
                    if I[rr][oc]==mc: O[rr][oc]=4; break
                    if rr==lr: break
                    O[rr][oc]=mc; rr+=dr
        else:
            dc=1 if oth[1]>lc0 else -1
            for mr,mc_,oc in marks:
                if oc<lc0 or oc>lc1: continue
                off=mr-lc0
                ro=oth[2]+off
                if not (oth[2]<=ro<=oth[3]): continue
                cc=ro+dc
                while 0<=cc<W:
                    if I[mr][cc]==mc: O[mr][cc]=4; break
                    if cc==lc0: break
                    O[mr][cc]=mc; cc+=dc
    return O

ok=True
for p in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    m=f(G[p+' input'])==G[p+' output']
    ok &= m
    print(p, m)
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

def segs(I):

        return -1 if b[2]>a[2] else 1

        if typ=='h': return pos in range(fr[2],fr[3]+1) and False  # placeholder

        own, oth = ds[0], ds[1]

            else: c+=1; continue
            while c<W and I[r][c]==v: c+=1
            segs.append(('h',r,s,c-1,v))
    for c in range(W):
        r=0
        while r<H:
            if I[r][c]!=bg: v=I[r][c]; s=r
            else: r+=1; continue
            while r<H and I[r][c]==v: r+=1
            segs.append(('v',c,s,r-1,v))
    segs.sort(key=lambda s:(s[3]-s[2]+1), reverse=True)

    def perp(r,c,f): return 1 if f[1]>r else -1 if f[0]<r else 0
    if not horiz:
        def step(mr,mp,f):
            d = 1 if f[2]>mp else -1 if f[2]<mp else 0
            return mr+d, mp
        def proj(mr,mp,f):
            return (frames[1-f][2], mp)
    else:
        def step(mr,mp,f):
            d = 1 if f[1]>mp else -1 if f[1]<mp else 0
            return mr, mp+d
        def proj(mr,mp,f):
            return (mr, frames[1-f][1])
    for m in sorted(mcells):

        own=f[0]; other=frames[1-f]
        # Ray A: from marker toward own frame, paint mc until crossing own frame line

        cc=(mr,mp); cnt=0

            if cc in set(mcells): O[cc[0]][cc[1]]=4; break
            O[cc[0]][cc[1]]=mc
            cnt+=1
        # Ray B: project onto other frame, then paint full cross line there
        target=proj(mr,mp,other)
        tR,tC=target
        # paint entire cross line through other frame at projected position? original paints whole row/col of other frame

        full_line = [tC] if horiz else [tR]
        if horiz:
            for cc_ in range(W):

        else:
            for rr_ in range(H):
                if (rr_,mp) in mcells: O[rr_][mp]=4
                elif I[rr_][mp]!=fc: O[rr_][mp]=mc
    return O

from collections import Counter

def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    segs=[]
    for r in range(H):
        c=0
        while c<W:
            if I[r][c]!=bg: v=I[r][c]; s=c
            else: c+=1; continue
            while c<W and I[r][c]==v: c+=1
            segs.append(('h',r,s,c-1,v))
    for c in range(W):
        r=0
        while r<H:
            if I[r][c]!=bg: v=I[r][c]; s=r
            else: r+=1; continue
            while r<H and I[r][c]==v: r+=1
            segs.append(('v',c,s,r-1,v))
    segs.sort(key=lambda s:s[3]-s[2]+1, reverse=True)
    frs=segs[:2]
    horiz=all(s[0]=='h' for s in frs)
    fc=frs[0][4]
    mset=set()
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r][c]!=bg and I[r][c]!=fc: mset.add((r,c))
    def seg_dist(m,f):
        if f[0]=='h': return abs(m[1]-f[1])
        return abs(m[0]-f[2])
    col={m:I[m[0]][m[1]] for m in mset}
    for m in sorted(mset):
        mr,mp=m
        oc=min(range(2), key=lambda k: seg_dist(m,frs[k]))
        ccol=col[m]; otherf=frs[1-oc]
        # Ray A: toward own frame
        if frs[oc][0]=='h':
            # direction toward nearer end of own span
            lo,hi=frs[oc][1],frs[oc][2]
            d=1 if hi-mr>mr-lo else -1 if mr-lo>hi-mr else 1
            cc=mr+d
            while True:
                cc+=d
                if not(0<=cc<W): break
                if I[mr][cc]==fc: break
                if (mr,cc) in mset: O[mr][cc]=4; break
                O[mr][cc]=ccol
        else:
            lo,hi=frs[oc][2],frs[oc][3]
            d=1 if hi-mp>mp-lo else -1 if mp-lo>hi-mp else 1
            rr=mp+d
            while True:
                rr+=d
                if not(0<=rr<H): break
                if I[rr][mp]==fc: break
                if (rr,mp) in mset: O[rr][mp]=4; break
                O[rr][mp]=ccol
        # Ray B: snap to nearest end of other frame span
        if otherf[0]=='h':
            lo,hi=otherf[1],otherf[2]
            d1=abs(mp-lo); d2=abs(hi-mp)
            pos = lo+d1 if d1<=d2 else hi-d2
        else:
            lo,hi=otherf[2],otherf[3]
            d1=abs(mr-lo); d2=abs(hi-mr)
            pos = lo+d1 if d1<=d2 else hi-d2
        if otherf[0]=='h':
            for cc in range(W):
                if I[pos][cc]==fc: continue
                if (pos,cc) in mset: O[pos][cc]=4
                else: O[pos][cc]=ccol
        else:
            for rr in range(H):
                if I[rr][pos]==fc: continue
                if (rr,pos) in mset: O[rr][pos]=4
                else: O[rr][pos]=ccol
    return O

from collections import Counter

def segs(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    L=[]
    for r in range(H):
        c=0
        while c<W:
            if I[r][c]!=bg: v=I[r][c]; s=c
            else: c+=1; continue
            while c<W and I[r][c]==v: c+=1
            L.append(('h',r,s,c-1,v))
    for c in range(W):
        r=0
        while r<H:
            if I[r][c]!=bg: v=I[r][c]; s=r
            else: r+=1; continue
            while r<H and I[r][c]==v: r+=1
            L.append(('v',c,s,r-1,v))
    return bg,L

def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); bg,L=segs(I)
    L.sort(key=lambda s:s[3]-s[2]+1, reverse=True)
    frs=L[:2]
    horiz=all(s[0]=='h' for s in frs)
    fc=frs[0][4]
    mset=set((r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=bg and I[r][c]!=fc)
    col={m:I[m[0]][m[1]] for m in mset}
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    def ray(m, own):
        mr,mp=m
        if own[0]=='h':
            lo,hi=own[1],own[2]
            step=1 if hi>mp else -1
            cc=mp+step
            while True:
                cc+=step
                if not(0<=cc<W): break
                if I[mr][cc]==fc: break
                if (mr,cc) in mset: O[mr][cc]=4; break
                O[mr][cc]=col[m]
        else:
            lo,hi=own[2],own[3]
            step=1 if hi>mr else -1
            rr=mr+step
            while True:
                rr+=step
                if not(0<=rr<H): break
                if I[rr][mp]==fc: break
                if (rr,mp) in mset: O[rr][mp]=4; break
                O[rr][mp]=col[m]
    for m in sorted(mset):
        mr,mp=m
        # own frame: the one whose span contains the marker's coordinate along the line axis
        in0 = frs[0][0]=='h' and frs[0][1]<=mp<=frs[0][2] or frs[0][0]!='h' and frs[0][2]<=mr<=frs[0][3]
        own = frs[0] if in0 else frs[1]
        ray(m, own)
        # Ray B: project onto other frame
        if horiz:
            p = frs[1-owner:=0 if False else 1-frs[0]][1]+(mp-frs[0][1]) if own==frs[0] else frs[0][1]+(mp-frs[1][1])
            for cc2 in range(W):
                if I[p][cc2]==fc: continue
                if (p,cc2) in mset: O[p][cc2]=4
                else: O[p][cc2]=col[m]
        else:
            p = frs[1-frs.index(own)][2]+(mr-frs[own][2])
            for rr in range(H):
                if I[rr][p]==fc: continue
                if (rr,p) in mset: O[rr][p]=4
                else: O[rr][p]=col[m]
    return O

                O[rr][mc]=col[m]
            span=(own[2],own[3]); lo,hi=span
            o=min(mc-lo, hi-mc); po=o if o==0 else o+1
            p=other[2]+po
            for rr2 in range(H):
                if I[rr2][p]==fc: continue
                if (rr2,p) in mset: O[rr2][p]=4
                else: O[rr2][p]=col[m]

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    segs=[]
    for r in range(H):
        c=0
        while c<W:
            if I[r][c]!=bg: v=I[r][c]; s=c
            else: c+=1; continue
            while c<W and I[r][c]==v: c+=1
            segs.append(('h',r,s,c-1,v))
    for c in range(W):
        r=0
        while r<H:
            if I[r][c]!=bg: v=I[r][c]; s=r
            else: r+=1; continue
            while r<H and I[r][c]==v: r+=1
            segs.append(('v',c,s,r-1,v))
    segs.sort(key=lambda s:s[3]-s[2],reverse=True)
    frs=segs[:2]
    fc=frs[0][3]
    mset=set((r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=bg and I[r][c]!=fc)
    col={m:I[m[0]][m[1]] for m in mset}
    for m in sorted(mset):
        mr,mc=m
        # own frame: the one whose span contains the marker's coordinate along the frame's axis
        def owns(i):
            o,_a,_b,_c,_v=frs[i]
            if o=='h' and _b<=mc<=_c: return True
            if o=='v' and _b<=mr<=_c: return True
            return False
        oi=0 if owns(0) else 1
        own=frs[oi]; other=frs[1-oi]
        vert = own[0]=='v'
        if vert:
            step=1 if own[1]>mc else -1
            cc=mc+step
            while True:
                cc+=step
                if not(0<=cc<W): break
                if I[mr][cc]==fc: break
                if (mr,cc) in mset: O[mr][cc]=4; break
                O[mr][cc]=col[m]
            off=mr-own[2]
            p=other[2]+off
            for cc2 in range(W):
                if I[p][cc2]==fc: continue
                if (p,cc2) in mset: O[p][cc2]=4
                else: O[p][cc2]=col[m]
        else:
            step=1 if own[1]>mr else -1
            rr=mr+step
            while True:
                rr+=step
                if not(0<=rr<H): break
                if I[rr][mc]==fc: break
                if (rr,mc) in mset: O[rr][mc]=4; break
                O[rr][mc]=col[m]
            off=mc-own[2]
            p=other[2]+off
            for rr2 in range(H):
                if I[rr2][p]==fc: continue
                if (rr2,p) in mset: O[rr2][p]=4
                else: O[rr2][p]=col[m]
    return O

ok=all(f(G[f'Demo pair {i} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {i} output'] for i in range(1,5))
print('all demos', ok)
if ok: print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    segs=[]
    for r in range(H):
        c=0
        while c<W:
            if I[r][c]!=bg: v=I[r][c]; s=c
            else: c+=1; continue
            while c<W and I[r][c]==v: c+=1
            segs.append(('h',r,s,c-1,v))
    for c in range(W):
        r=0
        while r<H:
            if I[r][c]!=bg: v=I[r][c]; s=r
            else: r+=1; continue
            while r<H and I[r][c]==v: r+=1
            segs.append(('v',c,s,r-1,v))
    # frames: longest segments
    segs.sort(key=lambda s:- (s[4]-s[2]))
    fs=segs[:2]
    fcolors={f[4] for f in fs}
    mset=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=bg and I[r][c] not in fcolors]
    def dist(m,f):
        _,_,s,e,_=f
        mr,mc=m
        if 'h' in f: return min(abs(mr-s),abs(mr-e),abs(mr-(s+e)//2))
        return min(abs(mc-s),abs(mc-e),abs(mc-(s+e)//2))
    def owns(m):
        mr,mc=m
        cands=[f for f in fs if ('h' in f and f[2]<=mc<=f[3]) or ('v' in f and f[2]<=mr<=f[3])]
        return min(cands,key=lambda f: dist(m,f))
    def paint_line(r,c,ccol,skip_frames=True):
        # paint perpendicular full line through (r,c), skip frame cells, markers->4
        for i in range(H if 'h' in str([fs]) else W):
            rr = r if False else None
        pass
    for m in sorted(mset):
        mr,mc=m; col=I[mr][mc]
        ow=owns(m); other=[f for f in fs if f is not ow][0]
        vert = ow[0]=='v'
        if vert:
            step=1 if ow[3]>mc else -1
            cc=mc+step
            while 0<=cc<W:
                if I[mr][cc] in fcolors: break
                if (mr,cc) in mset: O[mr][cc]=4; break
                O[mr][cc]=col; cc+=step
            ax=ow[2]  # start along axis
            off=mr-ax if ow[0]=='v' else mc-ax
            pr=other[2]+off
            pc=(other[1] if False else other[3])+off
            tr=pr
            cr=pc
            lo,hi=min(max(other[2],other[1]),max(other[3],other[2])), max(other[2],other[3])
            # project along other's axis: target index = other.start + off, clamped
            ti=max(min(other[2]+off, other[3]), other[2])
            tj=max(min(other[1]+off, other[3]), other[1])
            for cc2 in range(W):
                if I[ti][cc2] in fcolors: continue
                if (ti,cc2) in mset: O[ti][cc2]=4
                else: O[ti][cc2]=col
        else:
            step=1 if ow[3]>mr else -1
            rr=mr+step
            while 0<=rr<H:
                if I[rr][mc] in fcolors: break
                if (rr,mc) in mset: O[rr][mc]=4; break
                O[rr][mc]=col; rr+=step
            ax=ow[2]
            off=mc-ax
            ti=max(min(other[2]+off, other[3]), other[2])
            tj=max(min(other[1]+off, other[3]), other[1])
            for rr2 in range(H):
                if I[rr2][tj] in fcolors: continue
                if (rr2,tj) in mset: O[rr2][tj]=4
                else: O[rr2][tj]=col
    return O

def segs_of(I,bg):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); s=[]
    for r in range(H):
        c=0
        while c<W:
            if I[r][c]!=bg: v=I[r][c]
            else: c+=1; continue
            s_ = c
            while c<W and I[r][c]==v: c+=1
            s.append(('h',r,s_,c-1,v))
    for c in range(W):
        r=0
        while r<H:
            if I[r][c]!=bg: v=I[r][c]; s_=r
            else: r+=1; continue
            while r<H and I[r][c]==v: r+=1
            s.append(('v',s_,c,r-1,v))
    return s
